question: The average gini recalculated of the world in 2015
query: SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated) FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 AND iso IN ( SELECT iso FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 GROUP BY iso HAVING COUNT(iso) > 1 ) LIMIT 50
answer: The average Gini coefficient recalculated for the world in 2015 was approximately 0.392.
